compact_functional_control.domain: D_control=[0,1]xT^2 with ultrastatic metric -dt^2+dx^2+dy^2 and future coorientation dt
compact_functional_control.action: S_control[A]=-(1/4) integral F_{mu nu}F^{mu nu}; conventional Abelian Maxwell control with all lower-order coefficients zero
compact_functional_control.slice_carrier: H^{s+1}(T^2;R^2) for A and H^s(T^2;R^2) for E, with constants split as harmonic modes
compact_functional_control.gauge_differential: d0(phi)=(grad phi,0), owned by A -> A+d phi
compact_functional_control.constraint: C(A,E)=div E, from variation of A_0
compact_functional_control.evolution: partial_t A=E; partial_t E=Delta A-grad div A in the stated sign convention
compact_functional_control.closed_range: On nonzero Fourier modes k in Z^2, |k|^2>=1; grad maps mean-zero H^{s+1} isomorphically onto the exact H^s one-forms. Constants are the split kernel, so im(d0) is closed.
compact_functional_control.propagation: div(partial_t E)=0; the evolution fixes gradient gauge directions, descends to transverse Fourier quotient coordinates Q=k cross A and P=k cross E, and conserves 1/2(P^2/|k|^2+Q^2).

noncompact_control.result: D is injective but not bounded below, hence its range is not closed; the compact torus proof cannot be transferred without a Poincare/spectral gap or another closed-range theorem.

supplied_holonomy_control.carrier: rank-two real symplectic fibre with standard alternating form
supplied_holonomy_control.hyperbolic: M=diag(2,1/2), trace 5/2; M^T H M=H forces the first positive diagonal entry to zero
supplied_holonomy_control.parabolic: M=[[1,1],[0,1]], trace 2 with nontrivial Jordan block; M^T H M=H forces the first positive diagonal entry to zero
supplied_holonomy_control.result: For supplied SL(2,R) monodromy, elliptic/semisimple unit-circle behavior admits a positive invariant majorant, whereas hyperbolic and nontrivial parabolic controls do not. Trace two alone does not certify compact reduction.

packet_custody.reason: The Maxwell control and rank-two connection controls are independently supplied comparators with no typed map into either K77 carrier.

exact_control.scope: exact rational Fourier-generator, dilation-norm and rank-two matrix certificate; not a numerical PDE discretization or K77 carrier reduction
